mapper.insert: insert into log_download(aweme_id, title, media_type, origin_url, download_urls, parse_status, error_msg, create_time) values(#{awemeId}, #{title}, #{mediaType}, #{originUrl}, #{downloadUrls}, #{parseStatus}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, aweme_id, title, media_type, origin_url, create_time from log_download order by id
